abort.already_configured: This InvertirOnline account is already configured.

init.title: InvertirOnline Options
init.description: Configure additional fixed ticker sensors (comma-separated) and the polling interval (minimum 15 minutes).

data_description.extra_tickers: Comma-separated. Argentine market / CEDEARs / Bonds (bCBA by default): enter just the symbol (e.g. NVDA, GGAL, AL30, YPFD) or bCBA:NVDA. For USD MEP/CCL quotes append D or C (e.g. NVDAD, AL30D, AL30C). US stocks in USD: prefix with NYSE: or NASDAQ: (e.g. NYSE:KO, NASDAQ:AAPL).
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: Minimum 15 minutes to stay within IOL's 25,000 monthly API calls quota.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Update interval must be at least 15 minutes to protect your IOL API quota.
